title: 第0011章精英营的刺头第0012章血色武道馆诡异侵蚀的真相
content_zh:
;;
天刚蒙蒙亮，凰溪岛的海风就裹着淡淡的灵气，扫过度假区的武道馆。贾黑米是被一阵急促的敲门声吵醒的，宿醉般的疲惫还黏在骨头上，昨夜净化心灵裂缝时透支的气血，让他每动一下，四肢都透着酸软。
他撑着坐起来，才发现自己躺在武道馆的临时休息室里，身上盖着一件带着淡淡皂角香的白色武道服——是才依依的。昨夜被她接住后，他昏沉得厉害，只隐约记得导师安排人把他送过来，其余的便断了片。
敲门声还在响，带着几分不耐烦的节奏。贾黑米抓过武道服套上，布料蹭过皮肤时，还能感觉到一丝残留的温热，他心头微跳，赶紧拉开门。
门外站着个穿武道馆制式训练服的少年，眉眼倨傲，下巴抬得老高，胸前的徽章刻着“精英营·甲级”的字样，见贾黑米开门，少年上下扫了他一眼，嘴角扯出一抹讥讽：“你就是贾黑米？那个3.2卡气血，靠耍小聪明混进精英营的废物？”
贾黑米的眼神冷了下来。昨夜的蜕变让他不再是那个任人嘲讽的底层少年，但也没蠢到刚进营就惹事，他侧身让开道：“有事？”
“李教官让你去精英营训练场报到，迟到一秒，罚跑环岛十圈。”少年嗤笑一声，故意撞了下贾黑米的肩膀，带着一股不算弱的气血威压，“别以为解决了个温泉区的小诡异就上天了，精英营里，阿猫阿狗都比你强。”
说完，少年甩着袖子走了，走廊里传来他和其他学员的哄笑。贾黑米攥了攥拳，指节泛白，昨夜净化裂缝时觉醒的【心灵者·一阶】天赋似乎有了反应，他能清晰地感受到那少年话语里的嫉妒和傲慢——那是对方心灵里的漏洞，像一道敞开的门，稍一用力，就能窥见其心底的不堪。
他压下心底的异动，低头看了看自己的手掌。昨夜被黑猫抓出的伤口已经结痂，淡粉色的痂皮下，似乎有微弱的暖流在涌动，那是气血与心灵天赋融合的迹象，他能感觉到，自己的气血值似乎比之前高了一点，不再是堪堪3.2卡的废柴水准。
简单洗漱后，贾黑米朝着精英营训练场走去。凰溪岛武道馆分普通营和精英营，普通营在山脚，学员都是气血5卡以上的普通考生，而精英营在半山腰，背靠废弃的上古神殿，视野开阔，灵气浓度也比山脚高了数倍，能进来的，要么是气血超10卡的天才，要么是在武道考核中立过大功的特殊学员——贾黑米显然是后者。
训练场比他想象的还要大，地面是用特制的陨铁铺成，能承受武师境的全力一击，四周立着数十个智能靶机，不少学员已经在训练了，气血爆发的轰鸣声此起彼伏，灵气在他们周身萦绕，化作淡淡的光晕。
训练场的角落，站着几个教官，其中一个穿黑色作战服，面容刚毅，眉眼间带着一股肃杀之气，正是昨夜温泉区的带队导师，也是精英营的总教官，李烈。他的气血值高达18卡，是武师境中期强者，在凰溪岛武道馆，也是数一数二的高手。
除了李烈，训练场边还站着一个熟悉的身影——才依依。她依旧是一身白色武道服，长发束成高马尾，正拿着一把长剑练习基础刺击，剑气破空，精准地击中百米外的靶心，靶机瞬间爆裂，化作漫天碎片。
周围的学员都看呆了，不少男生眼中带着爱慕和敬佩，唯有几个甲级学员面色淡然，显然早已习惯了才依依的强悍。
贾黑米刚走到训练场边缘，李烈的目光就落了下来，那目光像两把尖刀，带着审视的意味，扫得贾黑米浑身一紧。
“贾黑米。”李烈开口，声音洪亮，盖过了训练场的嘈杂，“昨夜温泉区之事，你立了功，武道馆破格录取你进入精英营，按规矩，入营先测气血，亮天赋，让大家看看，你是不是真的有资格留在这。”
话音落下，训练场瞬间安静下来，所有学员的目光都集中在贾黑米身上，有好奇，有嘲讽，有不屑，还有才依依那略带探究的目光。
贾黑米走到训练场中央的气血测试仪前，深吸一口气，将手掌按在冰冷的仪器上。仪器发出一阵轻微的嗡鸣，屏幕上的数字开始跳动——3.5卡。
虽然只涨了0.3卡，离精英营的最低标准还有不小的差距，但这已经是贾黑米十几年来，气血值第一次主动增长，而非靠气血丹勉强维持。
“哈哈哈，3.5卡？还不如普通营的中等学员！”

“就这？也配进精英营？李教官怕不是被这小子骗了吧？”
“温泉区的诡异，说不定是才依依学姐解决的，他就是捡了个便宜！”
嘲讽声此起彼伏，刚才那个来叫贾黑米的少年更是直接喊道：“李教官，这废物根本没资格留在精英营，赶紧把他踢回普通营，别污了我们精英营的名声！”
李烈的脸色沉了下来，刚想开口，一道清冷的声音突然响起：“昨夜温泉区，若不是他净化了心灵裂缝，我就算能解决那些诡异，也至少要付出三成气血的代价，他的功劳，毋庸置疑。”
才依依收剑，走到贾黑米身边，目光扫过周围的学员，带着一股与生俱来的傲气：“精英营的规矩，是强者留，弱者走，但强者从不是只看气血值，若是连这点道理都不懂，不如趁早滚出精英营。”
她的气血值高达12.8卡，是精英营的第一人，连李烈都要让她三分，她一开口，周围的嘲讽声瞬间消失，那个喊得最凶的少年也涨红了脸，不敢再说话。
贾黑米看向才依依，心头微暖。昨夜的并肩作战，让两人之间少了最初的隔阂，他能感觉到，才依依的心灵很干净，像一块没有瑕疵的白玉，唯一的漏洞，或许就是那份刻在骨子里的骄傲，以及对自身天赋的过度苛求。
“气血3.5卡，确实不够。”李烈的声音再次响起，打破了训练场的沉默，“但昨夜你展现出的净化能力，是武道馆目前最需要的，邪神低语越来越频繁，我们需要能抵御侵蚀的武者。我可以让你留在精英营，但你必须接受特训，一个月后的精英营考核，若是你的气血值达不到7卡，或者无法在实战中展现出你的天赋，立刻滚出精英营，连普通营都不许进。”
“我接受。”贾黑米没有犹豫，一口答应。7卡的气血值，对以前的他来说是天堑，但现在他有了【心灵者】天赋，还有黑猫和叶利西的暗中相助，他有信心做到。
“好。”李烈点了点头，指了指训练场的一个角落，“从今天起，你归我亲自指导，你的特训内容，和其他人不一样，先从基础的气血锤炼开始，我这里有武道馆特制的淬体汤，每天泡一个时辰，配合气血丹，先把你的底子打牢。”
说着，他扔给贾黑米一个黑色的储物袋，里面装着十枚高级气血丹，还有一瓶泛着淡绿色光芒的药液，正是淬体汤的原液。
储物袋是武者的必备之物，里面有独立的空间，能装下不少东西，对现在的贾黑米来说，无疑是雪中送炭。他接过储物袋，拱手道：“谢谢李教官。”
“不用谢我，我只是为武道馆做事。”李烈摆了摆手，“记住，精英营不养闲人，要么变强，要么滚蛋。”
说完，李烈转身走向教官区，留下贾黑米站在训练场中央。周围的学员看他的目光变了些，有不少人眼中带着好奇，想知道这个气血只有3.5卡的少年，到底有什么特殊的能力，能让李烈亲自指导，还能让才依依为他说话。
就在这时，一道身影突然窜到贾黑米脚边，用脑袋蹭了蹭他的裤腿。贾黑米低头，只见黑猫蹲在他面前，金色的眼睛里带着一丝戏谑，嘴里还叼着一个小小的布包，扔到他的脚边。

As soon as the sky breaks, the sea breeze from Huangxi Island is wrapped in a faint aura and sweeps over the resort's martial arts hall. Jiahemi was woken up by a rapid knock on the door. The fatigue like a hangover was still clinging to his bones. The overdrawn energy and blood while purifying the cracks in his soul last night made his limbs feel sore every time he moved.
He pushed himself to sit up, only to find that he was lying in the temporary lounge of the martial arts hall, covered with a white martial arts uniform with a faint scent of soap locust - it belonged to Cai Yiyi. After he was caught by her last night, he was very sleepy. He only vaguely remembered that his mentor arranged for someone to send him here, and the rest was broken.
The knocking on the door was still ringing, with a somewhat impatient rhythm. Jia Heimi grabbed the martial arts uniform and put it on. When the fabric rubbed against his skin, he could still feel a trace of residual warmth. His heart skipped a beat and he quickly opened the door.
Standing outside the door was a young man wearing the standard training uniform of the martial arts gym. He had arrogant eyebrows and raised his chin. The badge on his chest was engraved with the words "Elite Camp Grade A". Seeing Jia Heimi open the door, the young man glanced at him and taunted him: "Are you Jia Heimi? That 3.2-calorie trash who sneaked into the elite camp by playing tricks?"
Jiahemi's eyes turned cold. The transformation last night made him no longer the low-level boy who was ridiculed, but he was not stupid enough to cause trouble as soon as he entered the camp. He stepped aside and said: "Is something wrong?"
"Instructor Li asked you to report to the training ground of the elite camp. If you are late for one second, you will be punished by running ten laps around the island." The young man sneered and deliberately bumped Jia Heimi's shoulder, with a pressure of blood that was not weak. "Don't think that you will be rewarded for solving a little weird thing in the hot spring area. In the elite camp, cats and dogs are better than you."
After saying that, the young man waved his sleeves and left, and he and other students laughed in the corridor. Jia Heimi clenched his fists, his knuckles turned white. The [Psychic One Level 1] talent awakened during the purification crack last night seemed to be responding. He could clearly feel the jealousy and arrogance in the young man's words - it was the loophole in the other person's heart, like an open door. With a little effort, you could see the unbearable depth of his heart.
He suppressed the strange movement in his heart and looked down at his palms. The wound scratched by the black cat last night has scabbed over, and there seems to be a weak warm current surging under the pale pink scab. This is a sign of the fusion of qi and blood with spiritual talent. He can feel that his qi and blood value seems to be a little higher than before, and is no longer a waste of 3.2 calories.
After washing briefly, Jiahemi walked towards the elite camp training ground. Huangxi Island Martial Arts Hall is divided into ordinary camp and elite camp. The ordinary camp is at the foot of the mountain, and the students are all ordinary candidates with more than 5 cards of qi and blood. The elite camp is on the middle of the mountain, backed by an abandoned ancient temple.
The training ground was larger than he imagined. The ground was paved with special meteorite iron, which could withstand a full blow from the martial arts realm. There were dozens of smart target drones standing around. Many students were already training. The roar of energy and blood burst out one after another, and the spiritual energy lingered around them, turning into a faint halo.
In the corner of the training ground, there were several instructors standing. One of them was wearing a black combat uniform, with a resolute face and a chilling air in his eyebrows. He was the instructor in the hot spring area last night and the chief instructor of the elite camp, Li Lie. His health value is as high as 18 cards. He is a strong man in the middle stage of the martial arts realm. He is also one of the top masters in the Huangxi Island Martial Arts Hall.
In addition to Li Lie, there is also a familiar figure standing by the training ground - Cai Yiyi. She was still wearing a white martial arts uniform, her long hair was tied into a high ponytail, and she was practicing basic thrusts with a long sword. The sword energy broke through the air and accurately hit the bullseye a hundred meters away. The target exploded instantly and turned into fragments all over the sky.
The students around were stunned, and many boys had admiration and respect in their eyes.Pei, only a few Grade A students looked calm, obviously they were used to Cai Yiyi's strength.
As soon as Jia Heimi reached the edge of the training ground, Li Lie's eyes fell down. His eyes were like two sharp knives, scanning with scrutiny, making Jia Heimi's whole body tense up.
"Jia Heimi." Li Lie spoke, his voice loud and clear, drowning out the noise of the training ground. "You made a great contribution to the incident in the hot spring area last night. The martial arts hall admitted you to the elite camp under special circumstances. According to the rules, you must first test your energy and blood before entering the camp, and show your talent, so that everyone can see whether you are really qualified to stay here."
After the words fell, the training ground instantly became quiet. All the students' eyes were focused on Jia Heimi, with curiosity, ridicule, disdain, and Cai Yiyi's slightly probing gaze.
Jiahemi walked to the qi and blood tester in the center of the training ground, took a deep breath, and pressed his palms on the cold instrument. The instrument buzzed slightly, and the number on the screen began to jump - 3.5 calories.
Although it only increased by 0.3 calories, which was still far from the minimum standard of the elite camp, this was the first time in more than ten years that Jia Heimi's Qi and blood values ​​had increased actively, rather than relying on Qi and blood pills to barely maintain it.
"Hahaha, 3.5 calories? Not as good as an average student from an ordinary camp!"
"That's it? Are you qualified to join the elite camp? Isn't Instructor Li deceived by this kid?"
"The weirdness in the hot spring area may have been solved by Senior Sister Cai Yiyi. He just took advantage of it!"
Ridicules arose one after another, and the young man who just called Jia Heimi shouted directly: "Instructor Li, this waste has no qualifications to stay in the elite camp. Kick him back to the ordinary camp quickly, don't tarnish the reputation of our elite camp!"
Li Lie's face darkened, and just when he was about to speak, a cold voice suddenly sounded: "If he hadn't purified the spiritual cracks in the hot spring area last night, even if I could solve those weird things, I would still have to pay at least 30% of my energy and blood. There is no doubt about his contribution."
Cai Yiyi sheathed her sword and walked to Jia Heimi. She glanced at the students around her and said with an innate arrogance: "The rules of the elite camp are that the strong stay and the weak go. But the strong never only look at the blood value. If you don't even understand this principle, it is better to get out of the elite camp as soon as possible."
Her health value was as high as 12.8 calories, making her the number one person in the elite camp. Even Li Lie wanted to give her three points. As soon as she opened her mouth, the sarcasm around her disappeared instantly. The boy who yelled the loudest blushed and did not dare to speak anymore.
Jia Heimi looked at Cai Yiyi, feeling warm in her heart. Fighting side by side last night, the initial barrier between the two disappeared. He could feel that Cai Yiyi's heart was very clean, like a flawless piece of white jade. The only flaw might be the pride engraved in her bones and her excessive demands for her own talent.
"3.5 calories of blood is indeed not enough." Li Lie's voice sounded again, breaking the silence in the training ground, "But the purification ability you showed last night is what the martial arts gym needs most at the moment. The whispers of the evil god are becoming more and more frequent. We need martial arts that can resist erosion. I can let you stay in the elite camp, but you must undergo special training. If your health value does not reach 7 cards in the elite camp assessment one month later, or you cannot show your talent in actual combat, you will be kicked out of the elite camp immediately, and you will not even be allowed to enter the ordinary camp."
"I accept." Jiahemi agreed without hesitation. The health value of 7 cards was a huge obstacle for him in the past, but now that he has the talent of [Psychic] and the secret help of Black Cat and Ye Lixi, he is confident that he can do it.
"Okay." Li Lie nodded and pointed to a corner of the training ground, "From today on, you will be under my personal guidance. The content of your special training is different from others. It starts with basic Qi and blood training. I have a special body-tempering soup made by the martial arts hall. Soak it for an hour every day, and combine it with Qi and blood pills to lay a solid foundation for you."
As he said that, he threw a black ball to Jiahemi.The storage bag contained ten high-grade Qi and Blood Pills, as well as a bottle of medicinal liquid glowing with light green light, which was the original liquid of the Body Tempering Decoction.
The storage bag is a must-have item for warriors. It has independent space and can hold a lot of things. For Jia Heimi now, it is undoubtedly a timely help. He took the storage bag and said, "Thank you, Instructor Li."
"You don't need to thank me, I'm just doing things for the martial arts gym." Li Lie waved his hand, "Remember, the elite can't support idlers. Either get stronger or get out."
After speaking, Li Lie turned around and walked towards the instructors' area, leaving Jia Heimi standing in the center of the training ground. The students around him looked at him differently, and many of them had curiosity in their eyes. They wanted to know what special abilities this young man with only 3.5 qi and blood had, allowing Li Lie to personally guide him and Cai Yiyi to speak for him.
At this moment, a figure suddenly rushed to Jiahemi's feet and rubbed his trouser leg with his head. Jia Heimi lowered his head and saw the black cat squatting in front of him, with a hint of teasing in its golden eyes, holding a small cloth bag in its mouth, and threw it at his feet.
